selection: Authored contrasts after complete reading of the three fixed learning cohorts; not exhaustive type annotation.

records.reference: this is important event please note on my calendar
records.rationale: My calendar is explicitly the collection receiving the event.

records.reference: what's on my calendar this month
records.rationale: What is on my calendar queries the entries of an identified event collection.

records.reference: repeat reminder for my schedule for christmas
records.rationale: My schedule for Christmas identifies an event/task collection; repeat ambiguity does not erase that role.

records.reference: link john@gmail dot com to john in contacts
records.rationale: In contacts explicitly identifies the contact-record collection for the linkage.

records.reference: look up in contacts
records.rationale: Lookup in contacts explicitly selects a contact-record collection.

records.reference: what did my wife leave to be done
records.rationale: Outstanding activities are queried, but no list/collection reference is expressed.

records.reference: please remove tomatoes from grocery list
records.rationale: Grocery list explicitly identifies an item collection.

records.reference: delete the song what if in my music
records.rationale: My music identifies a music library; no separate general list role is expressed.

records.reference: please play my pop playlist
records.rationale: My pop playlist is a specialized musical collection only.

records.reference: hi play me playlist of a r rehman songs released current year
records.rationale: Playlist of songs is a specialized musical collection, whether known or newly selected.

records.reference: can you show me list of my appointment
records.rationale: List of my appointments explicitly supplies an event collection.

records.reference: clear all concert schedule
records.rationale: Concert schedule is an event collection to clear.

records.reference: my new work schedule list
records.rationale: Work schedule list supplies collection meaning, but the bare fragment does not settle request relevance under the current scope.

records.reference: open my contact list
records.rationale: My contact list explicitly identifies the record collection to open.

records.reference: go to contacts and add a new email to the list
records.rationale: Contacts and list explicitly denote the collection receiving a new email address.

records.reference: add this email to my address book
records.rationale: Address book explicitly identifies the collection receiving the email record.

records.reference: how many contacts are there named john
records.rationale: Counting named contact records explicitly queries the contact collection.

records.reference: do i have the address for the apple store in my contacts
records.rationale: My contacts is the collection searched for a store address; collection does not imply all entries are human.

records.reference: contacts
records.rationale: Bare contacts could be people, a collection or an application fragment; neither role nor request scope is settled.

records.reference: eliminate the list kickball but make sure the contacts remain
records.rationale: The named kickball list is explicitly removed; contacts preservation does not change list presence.

records.reference: what are the titles of the lists in contacts
records.rationale: Titles of lists in contacts explicitly refers to record collections.

records.reference: could you please remove my card details from wallet
records.rationale: Wallet storing card details is a generic container/account object, not an expressed general/event/contact list.

records.reference: i want to cancel the recording i have on the dvr list for this morning
records.rationale: DVR list explicitly identifies a managed recording inventory, beyond merely naming a playback library.

records.reference: create a list of books to be ordered
records.rationale: List of books to be ordered is a task/item inventory, not a particular audiobook or media playlist.

records.reference: could you open my list app and check for groceries please
records.rationale: List app checked for groceries explicitly supplies the list function and item context; no proper list title is required.

records.reference: do i have any tasks today
records.rationale: Tasks today are activities; no collection identity or list object is expressed.

records.reference: olly what do i need to get done today
records.rationale: What needs doing asks activities, without a list reference.

records.reference: what are the things i need for my journey
records.rationale: Things needed for a journey are requested items, but no list/collection object is explicitly identified.

records.reference: make a new list of dog breeds
records.rationale: New list of dog breeds identifies the collection by its organizing description.

records.reference: open calendar
records.rationale: Open calendar can access a software application or a calendar collection; no collection-specific activity settles the referent.

records.reference: calendar
records.rationale: Bare calendar does not settle application, collection, calendar concept or request relevance.

records.reference: add an event to my google calendar for the date march twenty second please
records.rationale: Add an event to my Google calendar explicitly identifies the collection independently of software identity.

records.reference: schedule an uber in twenty minutes to tesco on fifth street
records.rationale: Schedule is the operation of booking one Uber ride, not a named collection.

records.reference: i want you to schedule a meeting with bryce jessie and carol for tomorrow at nine am
records.rationale: Schedule a meeting specifies the operation and event, without referring to a collection.

records.reference: are trains on schedule at ten
records.rationale: On schedule describes punctuality, not the schedule as a collection.

records.reference: can you check train schedule to berkeley
records.rationale: Train schedule queried by route identifies an organized service-event timetable.

records.reference: olly email jennifer the new schedule of the meeting for tomorrow
records.rationale: New schedule of the meeting could mean one revised time or an agenda/timetable collection; preserve the distinction.

records.reference: email work team this week's schedule
records.rationale: This weeks schedule is an identified collection of planned work events requested as email content.

records.reference: new scenario time or calendar to new list
records.rationale: Malformed scenario/time/calendar/new list wording leaves collection role and requested operation unclear.

admission: Same-author reference proposals, no listening or independent semantic certification; zero admission.
